upload_architecture.upload_pattern: Use SharePoint or OneDrive Request Files links as the secure upload-only entry point for clients.
upload_architecture.forms_policy: Microsoft Forms is allowed only for optional non-file metadata and must never replace the secure upload link for documents.
upload_architecture.source_of_truth_rule: The dashboard owns required-item status, reviewer decisions, and project state.
upload_architecture.external_access_rule: External users can upload only to the scoped request destination and must not browse unrelated files or folders.
upload_architecture.traceability_rule: Every mapping and submission stores dashboard canonical ids, Microsoft folder references, and durable callback metadata.
upload_architecture.review_gate_rule: Receipt detection creates a matched or unmatched submission record, but it does not automatically mark work complete.

mapping_defaults.default_record_strategy: Prefer item-level mappings for job_readiness_item records and fall back to job-level intake only when the requested item is intentionally grouped.
mapping_defaults.request_link_policy: Every active mapping must resolve to one governed Request Files link with a stable external id when available.
mapping_defaults.reviewer_resolution_rule: Use configured reviewers first, then fall back to the dashboard record owner.

matching_rules.description: Match directly on a dashboard-issued mapping id from the callback payload.
matching_rules.escalation_rule: If the mapping id is archived or not found, place the submission in the unmatched queue.

matching_rules.description: Match on the external Request Files identifier stored on the intake mapping.
matching_rules.escalation_rule: If multiple mappings resolve, route to human review instead of auto-matching.

matching_rules.description: Match on the exact request-link URL when the provider sends it back.
matching_rules.escalation_rule: If the URL is missing or ambiguous, continue to the next rule.

matching_rules.description: Match on SharePoint site, library, folder path, or folder URL when the request link metadata is absent.
matching_rules.escalation_rule: If folder coordinates resolve to more than one mapping, require human review.

matching_rules.description: Use dashboard record type and id hints when they are explicitly included in the callback metadata.
matching_rules.escalation_rule: Hints can narrow candidates but should not override explicit mapping identifiers.

matching_rules.description: Compare normalized file names to required-item labels for human-assisted review hints only.
matching_rules.escalation_rule: Never auto-complete from filename-only matching; keep the submission in review.

client_confirmation.recipient_rule: Send to the uploader email when a matched submission has a valid uploader address.
client_confirmation.suppression_rule: Suppress when the submission has no uploader email or a confirmation delivery is already recorded.

reviewer_notification.deep_link_rule: Link reviewers back to the originating dashboard record and submission review surface.
reviewer_notification.suppression_rule: Suppress duplicate notifications when the submission is already approved, rejected, or archived.

reminder_email.recipient_rule: Resolve the client recipient from the mapped record context or explicit override fields on the mapping.
reminder_email.suppression_rule: Suppress when the related required item is complete, the record is approved, the mapping is paused, or the reminder cadence window has not elapsed.

failure_alerting.suppression_rule: Never suppress unmatched submissions or callback failures from the diagnostics layer; surface and replay them explicitly.

exception_handling.unmatched_queue_rule: Any submission that cannot be matched with high confidence stays durable in the unmatched queue until a reviewer resolves it.
exception_handling.review_handling_rule: Reviewers can match, approve, reject, or create a new mapping from a real submission, but the dashboard still owns completion state.
exception_handling.retry_rule: Retry only through the dashboard-controlled replay and reminder sweep paths after fixing mappings, recipients, or template issues.
exception_handling.audit_rule: Every mapping change, submission receipt, reviewer action, reminder, and failure records both audit and diagnostics events.
exception_handling.reconciliation_rule: Reconcile Microsoft folder metadata and dashboard mappings before reprocessing failures; do not silently overwrite drift.

execution_order.title: Validate Phase 1 through Phase 4 Microsoft baselines and ensure mail automation is healthy.
execution_order.rollback: Do not enable Phase 5 until prerequisite diagnostics are green.

execution_order.title: Create or validate the governed SharePoint Request Files destinations for the pilot intake mappings.
execution_order.rollback: Disable or regenerate the request links before broader rollout.

execution_order.title: Create dashboard intake mappings for the pilot jobs and required items.
execution_order.rollback: Pause or archive the mappings if reviewers are not ready.

execution_order.title: Configure the upload receipt callback flow and validate the callback secret.
execution_order.rollback: Disable the callback flow and rotate the callback secret.

execution_order.title: Pilot matched, unmatched, reviewer notification, confirmation, and reminder scenarios.
execution_order.rollback: Disable client intake and work the unmatched queue before reopening.

manual_admin_checklist.step: Create the SharePoint or OneDrive Request Files destinations for the pilot intake mappings.
Confirm external users cannot browse the destination library or sibling folders.
Configure the callback flow to post upload receipts into /api/integrations/microsoft/client-intake/callback.
Set MICROSOFT_365_CLIENT_INTAKE_CALLBACK_SECRET and confirm the worker can call the internal reminder sweep.
Create pilot mappings and review /api/admin/system/microsoft-client-intake before any external send.

validation_checklist: Every intake mapping resolves to a single governed upload destination and request link.
Matched uploads create durable submission records with dashboard and Microsoft references.
Unmatched uploads remain visible in diagnostics until a reviewer resolves them.
Confirmation sends, reviewer notifications, and reminder sends all leave durable logs.
Required-item completion remains dashboard-controlled and is never inferred from receipt alone.
rollback_principles: Disable MICROSOFT_365_CLIENT_INTAKE_ENABLED before changing request-link topology in a live environment.
Never delete unmatched submissions to hide failures; review or archive them explicitly.
Rotate callback secrets before reopening intake after a misrouted or untrusted callback.
Pause mappings instead of widening external access when reviewer capacity is constrained.
